profile.title: Cloud Security and IAM Engineer
profile.bio: Cloud Security and IAM Engineer with 4+ years of experience in enterprise security delivery, identity and access management, and cloud infrastructure automation. I design access controls (RBAC/ABAC, SSO with SAML, OIDC and OAuth 2.0), automate identity governance and compliance checks, and secure AWS and Azure environments against NIST and CIS Benchmarks. Hands on with Python, PowerShell and Java, containerized deployments, and enterprise observability tools.
